children: Debenhams Group's turnaround strategy is starting to pay off, Shore Capital's Katie Cousins and Clive Black write in a note. The U.K. clothing retailer expanded its margins as the group's return rate declined in the first half of its fiscal year. "Encouragingly, Pretty Little Thing, Boohoo and Karen Millen all returned to growth," they say. The company's operational execution and balance sheet progress exceed what the U.K. investment group had expected the business to be 12-18 months ago. Shares in Boohoo Group, which trades as Debenhams, are up 1% at 25 pence. (najat.kantouar@wsj.com)
